name: New Jersey
permitAge: 16 (special learner permit, enrolled in behind-the-wheel driver training; MVC); 17 (examination permit, no driver training needed; N.J.S.A. 39:3-13)

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, including 10 at night, logged on form BA-CSD (one secondary source only; not confirmed on an MVC page)
teen.holdPermit: At least 6 months of supervised driving before the road test (N.J.S.A. 39:3-13 via MVC)
teen.nightLimit: Permit and probationary: no driving 11:01 p.m. to 5:00 a.m., except work, religious activity or emergency with verification (MVC)
teen.passengerLimit: Probationary under 21: one passenger plus the driver's dependents, unless a parent or guardian is in the car (MVC, N.J.S.A. 39:3-13.4)
teen.phone: Permit and probationary: no hand-held or hands-free wireless device. All drivers: hand-held ban; first offense 00 to 00, third offense 00 to 00 with 3 points and possible 90-day suspension.

notes: Supervising driver: at least 21, valid New Jersey license, at least 3 years of driving experience, in the front seat (MVC).
GDL decals: two removable reflective decals, $4 a pair; not displaying them is a $100 fine (MVC, N.J.S.A. 39:3-13.4). Placement on front and rear plates is from secondary sources only.
Failed knowledge test: retake after 7 days (MVC page via search snippet).
Test format 50 questions, 40 correct (80 percent) is from test-prep sites, not an MVC page.
School bus (N.J.S.A. 39:4-128.1): undivided road, both directions stop; opposite side of a safety island, raised median or barrier: slow to no more than 10 mph.
Keep right (N.J.S.A. 39:4-82): left lane only to pass or turn left; fine $100 to $300 (news source).
Move Over: change lanes or slow below the limit; $100 to $500; also disabled vehicles with hazard lights; pedestrians and bicyclists: change lanes or leave 4 feet, else slow to 25 mph (news sources).
Handbook: no official driver manual URL was found in search results (only third-party copies). The MVC is said to publish a Spanish manual, but no official URL was confirmed.
